guarantees.claim: Each output (in_ready_o, out_valid_o, state_we_o, sub_bytes_en_o, sub_bytes_out_ack_o, key_full_we_o, key_dec_we_o, key_expand_en_o, key_expand_out_ack_o, crypt_d, dec_key_gen_d) is driven by a combinational type conversion of the corresponding sp_* signal via sp2v_e.

alert_o, prng_update_o, prng_reseed_req_o, and key_expand_clear_o are each driven high when any bit of the corresponding multi-bit input (mr_alert, mr_prng_update, mr_prng_reseed_req, mr_key_expand_clear) is high.
prng_reseed_d, key_clear_d, and data_out_clear_d are each driven high only when all bits of the corresponding multi-bit input (mr_prng_reseed_d, mr_key_clear_d, mr_data_out_clear_d) are high.

assumptions.claim: The multi-bit input vectors (mr_alert, etc.) are driven by all active cipher cores such that a bit set to 1 reliably indicates the condition for which the OR/AND reduction is expected.
assumptions.cond: when any cipher core is operational
assumptions.risk: Outputs may be incorrectly asserted/deasserted, leading to lost alerts, spurious updates, or permanent stalling of clear sequences.

assumptions.claim: The sp2v_e type conversion function preserves the logical value and does not truncate or extend bits in a way that alters the intended control behavior.
assumptions.risk: Mismatch could cause handshake signals to be misinterpreted, resulting in data loss or protocol deadlock.

uncertain_points.claim: The AND-reduction clear signals (prng_reseed_d, key_clear_d, data_out_clear_d) require all bits of the multi-bit input to be high; if any core permanently fails to assert its bit (e.g., because it is idle, disabled, or stuck), the clear will never occur, potentially deadlocking state machines.
uncertain_points.cond: when at least one cipher core does not assert its clear bit
uncertain_points.risk: Deadlock or inability to clear secret/key/data_out state, leading to functional hang or security leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: The exact mapping between multi-bit slice inputs (mr_*) and the individual cipher cores is not evident from this chunk; the reduction policy (OR vs AND) may hide a mismatch in bit-width or core count assumptions.
uncertain_points.risk: Undetected mismatch could cause partial failure where some cores are not correctly aggregated.
